subject: Study 3687 Participant Unable to Join
body:
Hello!
I am having trouble getting a participant onboarded. She put in her email and signed up in the ethica app. I ensured it was the right app, and that the email matched the one we had. When it asked her for the study code, I gave it to her (after I sent the invite email), and it said she was not invited. I double-checked the email and the code - same thing again. I even had her go into the app through the invite email, and got the same result. I had her close out the app and go back in…no better. I did double check in writing that the emails were the same.
 
The email address and username were daulphin@cox.net. The study ID is 3687 and the Participant ID assigned through the invite was 103040.
 
Thanks!
Clare Schuchardt
 
Clare Schuchardt-Vogt MPH, RN, CPH
PhD Student, Arizona State University
Research Assistant, College of Nursing and Healthcare Innovation
Cschucha@asu.edu
314-825-5418

subject: Study 3687 Participant Unable to Join
body:
Hello Clare,


I hope this email finds you well. I apologize for the inconvenience caused during the onboarding process of the participant. I have shared this issue with our technical team for further investigation.


In the meantime, please ask the participant to follow these steps to join the study:

  1. Open the Avicenna Research app.
  2. Navigate to Settings -> Join Study -> Registration Code.
  3. Enter the study ID 3687 in the given field and tap on the JOIN STUDY button.

If the participant continues to face issues, please let me know and I'll be happy to assist further.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.


Best regards,
Ahmad

Feel free to make any additional adjustments as needed!


Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/25323/1a79814092d0abe1

subject: Study 3687 Participant Unable to Join
body:
Hi Clare,

As far as I have tested our application, I didn’t see any inconsistency in the procedure of joining a study. It would be helpful if you could add me to your study as a researcher with full access to all parts of the study. This way, I can check your study in depth.

Could you please do this for me?


My email address is: ahmad@avicennaresearch.com


If you are unsure how to add me to your study, please refer to this link:

https://learn.avicennaresearch.com/reference/study-setup-and-deployment/roles-and-permissions
